title: Blockfield
description: A Minecraft server in version 1.20.1 that's meant to bring a modern shooter-style experience to Minecraft, using several mods to achieve that.
body:
A Minecraft server in version 1.20.1 that's meant to bring a modern shooter-style experience to Minecraft, using several mods to achieve that.

It currently includes features such as:

Team-based matches

Class selection

Killstreak rewards

Sentry turrets

UAV / Airstrike system

Bots / NPC enemies

Custom battle ambience through a resource pack

Support for multiple maps (WIP)

The goal is to have a mix of classic FPS shooters such as Call of Duty and Battlefield, while still staying within the game.

I'm still actively developing it, improving systems such as multiple-map support, class gadgets, sound design, and combat polish.

I'd love to receive feedback in the meantime from people who enjoy engaging in shooter-inspired gameplay and testing and balancing ideas.

The current mods required are:

Timeless and Classics Zero Guns
LesRaisins Append Pack
LesRaisins Tactical Equipment
LesRaisins Armor
GeckoLib
Curios API
